adjudication.rationale: Diff shows `CalendarManager.createEvent` now accepts `externalId?: string` and returns it as `externalId` in the `EventResult` (packages/core/CalendarManager.ts). `EventManager` now records booking references using `externalCalendarId: isCalendarType ? result.externalId : undefined` (packages/core/EventManager.ts ~lines 164 and ~203). However, in `createAllCalendarEvents`, the branch where a destination has **no `credentialId`** calls `createEvent(c, event)` without the `externalId` argument (packages/core/EventManager.ts in the `else` branch under `if (destination.credentialId)`). That makes `result.externalId` undefined, so `externalCalendarId` becomes undefined for those created events, whereas previously it used `evt.destinationCalendar?.externalId`. This is verifiable from the diff and can break subsequent update/delete flows that rely on `externalCalendarId` to pick the right calendar.
